A '''chainmail chestplate''' is the [[Chainmail armor|chainmail]] [[Armor#Chestplate|chestplate]], crafted from {{MCW|Chain|iron chains}}. It gives 6 armor and has 300 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/chainmail_chestplate.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/chainmail/chestplate</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 6 armor. The vanilla item gives 5 armor with 240 durability.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Thorns]] III

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Chainmail armor]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>
